results.text: Bisoprolol to prevent adverse cardiac events (PACE) in COPD: a multicentre, double-blind, randomised, controlled, phase 3 trial. Safety profiles of the angiotensin converting enzyme inhibitors captopril and enalapril. The safety profiles of the angiotensin converting enzyme inhibitors, captopril and enalapril, are the focus of this review. Adverse effects are reviewed as those associated with sulfhydryl compounds and as those considered class-specific adverse effects of angiotensin converting enzyme inhibitors.
